name: tool-argument-guardrail
how_to_use: Question text is generated per tool argument at call time. Use inside a Strands InterventionHandler (see strands_agent.py).

question.instructions: Did the student mention or clearly ask about 'Dynamic Programming' (the value used for 'concept_name' in the call to get_concept_mastery)?

criteria.true: 'Dynamic Programming' appears in, or is clearly implied by, what the student said
criteria.false: the student never mentioned 'Dynamic Programming'; the agent guessed it

state_shape: see P.build_state(...) - only the user's/student's own words
wiring:
from backend.app.decider import patterns as P
from backend.app.decider.client import get_client
from backend.app.decider.calibration import get_thresholds

thr = get_thresholds()
decisions, ask = P.run_patterns(get_client(), state, [P.grounded_tool_arg(tool, arg, value)  # built per call by DeciderToolGuard], thr.get)   # ONE round trip for all patterns
d = decisions["grounded_concept_name"]
if d.triggered:          # plain Python owns the control flow
    ...                  # return Guide(feedback='Ask the student which concept they mean')
note: Question text is generated per tool argument at call time. Use inside a Strands InterventionHandler (see strands_agent.py).
